create_GPT2Tokenizer: create a GPT2Tokenizer instance from vocab and merges files for byte-level BPE tokenization
build_bpe_token: build byte-pair encoding for a token string using the cached BPE merge rules
test_tokenize_text: test tokenizing text into BPE tokens with byte-level encoding and regex pattern matching
convert_tokens_to_string: convert a sequence of BPE tokens back into a decoded UTF-8 string
save_vocabulary_directory: save the tokenizer vocabulary and BPE merge files to a specified directory
